author: Swainson, 1832
summary: 겨울철 주로 동해안과 남해안에서 보이는 비교적 드문 겨울철새로, 해안과 하구, 먼바다에서 무리를 지어 지낸다. 잠수해 조개류와 갑각류 등을 먹고, 옮겨 다닐 때는 물 위를 낮게 난다. 번식기에는 유라시아 대륙 북부, 알래스카 서부, 아이슬란드, 뉴펀들랜드섬 등 아한대~한대 툰드라나 숲 지대의 민물 못, 호소, 하천에 살며, 풀숲 바닥에 풀잎과 줄기로 접시 모양 둥지를 틀고 알 8~10개를 낳는다. 유럽 연안, 아프리카 북서부 연안, 캄차카, 한국, 중국, 일본, 북미 해안에서 월동한다.

art.subject: Black Scoter (Melanitta americana), adult male in winter, as seen off Korean coasts from November to March: entire plumage glossy black, from the rounded head to the tail, with no white anywhere on the head or wings; underwing coverts black, flight feathers slightly paler grey below. Bill black, with a large, rounded, bright yellow-orange swelling (knob) covering the base of the upper mandible and rising above the line of the culmen; iris dark brown; legs and feet blackish.
art.pose: riding the swell on the open sea as part of a loose flock
art.scene: Korean winter East Sea coastline with open grey sea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: all-black plumage, black bill with a broad bright yellow-orange knob at the base
adult female, side view swimming: blackish-brown body and dark cap reaching to the eye, sharply contrasting pale grey-brown cheeks, chin and neck sides, dark bill without a knob
art.build: Stocky, heavy-bodied sea duck, about 48cm, a little smaller than a Mallard. Rounded head with a fairly steep forehead; bill shorter than the head, broad, swollen at the base by the knob. Floats low in loose flocks on the sea and dives for shellfish; moves low over the water. Legs short, dark, set far back. At rest the wingtips reach the base of the tail. Tail rather long and pointed, often raised above the water. In flight all dark above; from below the flight feathers look paler silvery-grey than the black coverts.
avoid: Do not add white on the head or wings; a white eye crescent and white wing patches belong to Stejneger's Scoter.
Do not paint an orange-red bill tip or a black knob; on this species the knob is yellow and the rest of the bill black.
Do not paint the female's pale face as two separate spots; it is one large pale grey-brown cheek-and-throat area.
